operating_income.source: Operating income not reported in XBRL (null). Proxy = pretax income (IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxes...) + InterestExpenseDebt, accession 0000093410-26-000078: 29584+469, 27506+594, 19743+1217. Reviewer should verify vs 10-K.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 revenue fell 6.8% on lower commodity prices; modest recovery in 2026 then ~inflation-level growth. No price deck used.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: proxy EBIT margin was 15.0%/13.9%/11.1% for FY2023-25; 12% is a mid-cycle level between FY2025 and 3-yr average (13.3%).

tax_rate.source: Assumption: Damodaran US Integrated Oil/Gas effective tax rate 28.2% (dataset 2026-01-05).

wacc.source: Assumption. CAPM check: Rf 4.86% (US 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta ~0.31 (Damodaran unlevered 0.278, D/E 0.138) x ERP 4.46% = ~6.2% CoE, ~5.8% WACC; that beta looks too low for a cyclical commodity producer, so 8% is used as a conservative judgment. Reviewer to revisit.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and in line with long-run inflation; mature, depleting-resource business.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 50,699 - cash 7,285 - ST investments 0, accession 0000093410-26-000078
